narr: One flash flood occurred on Coal Creek. A nearby spotter measured 5 inches of rainfall during the event. In the next event, a flash flood reportedly moved several vehicles along with some heavy equipment.
ev: A storm produced 5 inches of rain along Coal Creek, followed by flash flooding.
Heavy rain produced flash flooding. The floodwaters moved several cars, along with some heavy equipment.
lsr: FLASH FLOOD ON COAL CREEK. TIME ESTIMATED. SPOTTER JUST EAST OF THIS LOCATION HAD MORE THAN 5 INCHES OF RAIN, MOSTLY BETWEEN 8 AND 10 PM.
EARLIER FLOODING HAD MOVED SEVERAL CARS AND SOME HEAVY EQUIPMENT. WATER WAS STILL RUNNING 3 INCHES DEEP ACROSS THE ROAD.
